dossier.identity: gentle shelter-bearer who opens a hardlight umbrella over the squad and blooms a sanctuary for anyone who needs to breathe~ :3
dossier.selectionRationale: a support-leaning bastion whose protection is a projected canopy and a zone rather than a body wall: aegis and balthazar hold a place, iris holds a line, serein shelters people and moves with them, so frontline squads can run a mobile guard.
dossier.weaponConcept: R-L7 petal compact rail carbine (forearm-mounted rail carbine with rail coil, core and magazine) paired with a hardlight umbrella shield projector (three-panel canopy ribs, projector core and control handle)

lore.backstory: former district-shelter coordinator who learned that a roof is only a promise until somebody holds it up~ uwu. she built a folding hardlight umbrella from a collapsed bus-stop projector and carries it everywhere, with a petal-light carbine for the people who do not respect umbrellas.
lore.syndicateRecord: charged with 212 counts of unlicensed sheltering, including covering a protest, a wedding and a corporate raid with the same canopy.
lore.psychProfile: calm, warm, absolutely immovable, asks everyone if they have eaten before she asks them to stand behind her xo.
lore.combatQuote: “shelter gives people the courage to move forward, bestie~ stay under the pink glass and bloom n__n”

iconFamily.subject: a bold umbrella canopy sheltering a single chunky rose
iconFamily.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one base raster concept for a game ability icon, to be traced into SVG. Character: Serein. Theme: rose canopy. Subject: a bold umbrella canopy sheltering a single chunky rose. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. Flat solid black monochromatic ink on genuinely transparent background. Exceptionally bold clean outer contour, broad shapes and large negative-space gaps. Recognizable at 24 to 30 pixels. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
iconFamily.method: built-in image generation, then silhouette tracing, then four SVG variations
